- Source arrays reference the package's own upstream GitHub releases/tags (github.com/shixin-guo/picot and github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono), with sha256sums pinned for the main tarball and per-architecture binaries. These are conventional AUR source declarations, not active downloads at this stage.

- Function bodies (`prepare()`, `build()`, `package()`) are defined but never invoked during the printsrcinfo step, so their contents are out of scope for this gate.

Nothing in the global scope would execute harmful code when the file is sourced.
